root_cause.text: In `mt7925_tx_check_aggr()` in the mt76/mt7925 Wi-Fi driver, the code dereferenced `sta->link[wcid->link_id]` before checking whether `sta` was NULL, so a missing station pointer could trigger a NULL pointer dereference crash.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (!sta) return;` before `link_sta = rcu_dereference(sta->link[wcid->link_id]);`, and removes the later combined check `if (!sta || !(link_sta->ht_cap.ht_supported || link_sta->he_cap.has_he))`, confirming the bug was the NULL check being placed after the dereference.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add an early NULL check for `sta` in aggregation handling to prevent crashes from invalid station pointers.
intent_record.what: The function `mt7925_tx_check_aggr()` now performs an early `if (!sta) return;` check before dereferencing `sta->link[wcid->link_id]`, and the later conditional was simplified by removing `!sta` from `if (!sta || !(link_sta->ht_cap.ht_supported || link_sta->he_cap.has_he))` so it now only checks the HT/HE capability of `link_sta`.
intent_record.how: This prevents a null pointer dereference when `sta` is NULL by exiting before `sta` is accessed. The functional behavior for valid stations is unchanged, except the capability check is now clearer and only depends on `link_sta` after it has already been validated.
